semanticAmendments.boundary: DialogContent and AlertDialogContent modal overlay layout; existing portal and modality limitations remain unchanged.

convention.name: overlayScope
convention.meaning: The layout boundary of a Dialog or AlertDialog modal overlay grid.
convention.whenToUse: Choose viewport or container layout for the Dialog or AlertDialog overlay, independently of the portal mount target.
convention.avoid: Portal mount targets, generic positioning, collision boundaries or claims of locally scoped modality.

convention.name: pending
convention.meaning: A consumer-declared action is in flight for a modal, temporarily locking its owned dismissal controls.
convention.whenToUse: Declare an in-flight action on a modal root while the consumer owns completion, progress and recovery.
convention.avoid: Automatic Promise tracking, arbitrary child controls, per-control loading, collection refresh or progress values.
